about: Superconductors that others have reported or predicted, which the screening (ml/screen.py) must never list as ours. SuperCon, 3DSC and the Alexandria and JARVIS electron-phonon data are checked separately; this file adds the finds and predictions we track, as in the app's AI view and recent advances. A "formula" matches a material with the same elements and every share within 2 at.%; a "system" matches every material made of exactly those elements, for families whose exact compositions vary. Add an entry whenever anyone tells us of an earlier report: the next screening round leaves it out, and the app hides a listed candidate marked with "prior" in progress.json.
